Title: NETMESSAGE:Kill about 80% of aliens in the labyrinth to progress
Translation: 击杀迷宫中约80%的外星人以继续前进

Title: NETMESSAGE:Most of aliens have been killed in the labyrinth and the door is open now, move out!
Translation: 迷宫中的大部分外星人已被击杀，门已打开，快出去！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Scientist: Greetings squad! Did you come to stop the Gman?
Translation: 科学家：队员们好！你们是来阻止G-man的吗？

Title: NETMESSAGE:I need three purple crystals for my experiments in a small area of Xen.
Translation: 我需要三颗紫色水晶用于我在Xen小区域的实验。

Title: NETMESSAGE:If you bring me the crystals, I will give you access to the Gman final room, good luck!
Translation: 如果你把水晶带来，我就给你进入G-man最终房间的权限，祝你好运！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Scientist: Great! I can continue with my experiments now, be careful stopping the plans of the Gman!
Translation: 科学家：太好了！我现在可以继续我的实验了，小心阻止G-man的计划！
